column1: # FRASIL's words for a screen reader (fm1-reader): the text on the screen <TAB> what to say.
# The firmware sends its screen's own text (app/speak.c); the reader says it with these words, then fm1-base's common
# ones (base/tools/gen_words.py: FX, ENV, REC, ms, Hz...). "#" takes a number, the longest entry wins. A change makes a
# new words file (app/web/words/<id>.json): keep every one, a device points at its own.
# an LFO's targets: the layer's first letters
